aliases: 5MP Indoor Fixed-focal Wi-Fi Pan & Tilt Network Camera
features: motorized pan & tilt (Pan 0-355, Tilt -55 to 60) with auto tracking
smart dual light: IR + warm-light colorful night vision (up to 10 m)
Wi-Fi 6 dual-band (2.4/5 GHz) + RJ-45 ethernet + Bluetooth pairing
dual-microphone, 2 W / 110 dB speaker, two-way talk
AI human, pet, face and gesture recognition, baby crying detection
microSD up to 512 GB, DMSS app
release_notes: The Dahua Hero H5JS is a 5MP indoor fixed-focal Wi-Fi 6 pan & tilt camera with auto tracking, smart dual-light colorful night vision, an F1.6 lens at up to 25 fps, and advanced AI including face, gesture and baby-cry detection. Verified against the official Dahua datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Consumer Wi-Fi pan-tilt camera managed via the DMSS app; ONVIF/RTSP is not stated on the datasheet. Add via the Generic Camera integration if RTSP is exposed.

blue_iris.notes: Select the 'Dahua' profile; RTSP is not confirmed on the datasheet.
